patch_description: Reverts the previous output-mixer addition (which regressed score from 0.61 to 0.57 by adding a redundant final RY layer that interfered with the readout alignment) and instead applies the recommended idea of softly breaking symmetry between entangling shells at zero parameter cost. Since apply_ansatz_block (outside the evolve block) does not support arbitrary scale factors, we achieve an equivalent, schema-legal multiplier by repeating the CRZ gate on each distance-4 (antipodal) edge twice. Two consecutive CRZ(theta_z) applications on the same wire pair compose additively into a single effective CRZ(2*theta_z) rotation, giving the long-range antipodal shell double the effective coupling strength relative to the nearest-neighbor and skip shells -- directionally matching the recommendation to boost the far-shell coupling -- while preserving full rotational symmetry within each shell (all edges in a shell still get identical treatment), which prior logged experiments showed is critical: anisotropic/asymmetric treatment within a shell collapsed training. This keeps the 2-distinct-parameter economy (theta_ry, theta_z) that scored best while diversifying the effective entangling structure.
